summary: Astrotech filed an 8-K announcing board approval to pursue a sale of its subsidiary 1st Detect, which owns the TRACER 1000 mass spectrometry ETD. No price, premium, or buyer is disclosed at this early stage. The board recommends the process, although no financial advisor is named. The filing serves as a preliminary strategic review instead of a definitive agreement. The company intends to focus on space initiatives. What to watch: progress on DHS/TSA/ECAC certifications, any definitive agreement with a buyer, and the timeline to close.
